title: Google Keep's 'Find in note' search feature rolling out for Android users
description: Last year, Google began working on a feature called "Find in note" for Google Keep on Android, which lets users search within notes. The feature is now rolling out to all Google Keep users on Android. To search within a note in Google Keep, open the note, tap the three-dot menu button in the bottom-right corner, tap on the "Find in note" option, and enter what you want to find. Your search term will appear highlighted in yellow throughout the note. It's similar to pressing Ctrl+F on a PC. title: Our Redmi Note 17 Pro battery life and charging tests are ready
description: The global Redmi Note 17 Pro uses the same Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset as the Chinese version of the phone. It has a smaller Si/C battery, but the loss is minimal – 8,340mAh instead of 9,000mAh. And it’s a huge upgrade over the old Redmi Note 15 Pro, which had a 6,580mAh battery. Xiaomi also boosted the charging hardware and the new model supports 67W HyperCharge, up from 45W. description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE may as well have been called the S26 AI. When designing this phone, the company’s focus was on new AI features and the utility they offer in day-to-day tasks.
